test_title: PYST 56: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the amount (integral value only) if a sum of Rs. 6,500 is being borrowed at 10% interest per annum for 2 years if interest is compounded half-yearly.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = 6500

Rate of interest (R) = 10%

Time (T) = 2 years

**Concept used:**

When rate of interest is compounded half-yearly

then rate will be half and time will be doubled

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + (R%/100))T

**Calculation:**

We have

R (half-yearly) = 5% and T = 4 years

⇒ A = 6500 × (1 + (5/100))⁴

⇒ A = 6500 × 
(1 + (1/20))⁴

⇒ A = 6500 × (21/20)⁴ = 7900 approx

**∴ The correct answer is 7900.**
